main.description: Imports earlier messages from someone on another service into a linked channel or a thread beside it, after an admin asked for a history import. The community writes each message at its original time, and clients see them only when they load history.

community.description: The community the registration belongs to.

channel.description: The linked channel, or a thread beside it, the messages go into.

results.description: One result per message, in input order.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: RegistrationNotFound
errors.description: The community has no bridge registration with that id.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not the bridge this registration belongs to.

errors.name: RegistrationDisabled
errors.description: An admin has paused this registration.

errors.name: ChannelNotLinked
errors.description: The channel is not linked to this registration.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The bridge sent too many requests. Retry after the interval in the response headers.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

errors.name: BackfillNotRequested
errors.description: No admin has asked for a history import on this channel.

errors.name: OutsideBackfillRange
errors.description: A message was sent before the requested range or after the request.

importedMessage.description: A message from the room's earlier history.

facets.description: Annotations over ranges of the text.

parent.description: The message this one replies to.

items.description: A file uploaded earlier with uploadBlob.

forward.description: Content forwarded from another Colibri message.

remoteMessage.description: The message's id on the other service.

createdAt.description: When the message was sent on the other service.

importResult.description: Where an imported message was written.

remoteMessage.description: The message's id on the other service.

rkey.description: Record key of the record the community wrote.
